properties.description: A reasoning read-back says each premise's reason once: a premise row's `why` holds its reason's leading clause, the page cites each full reason once in `premise_whys` (or in the premise's own claim row on the page), and an advisory sentence a reason would repeat (an unverified citation's, an undocumented report's) is said once in `advisories` with the ids it applies to. Used by reasoning_report's page builder (tools/query.rs, reasoning_page).
properties.name: said_once.rs
